what: Evidence paths cited by tracked files that do NOT resolve in HEAD, as of the commit that introduced the gate.
why: `.openclinxr` is gitignored and `git add` on an ignored path exits 0 without staging, so a citation can outlive the file it names. 682 files under that root ARE tracked by force-add, so the ignore rule is a trap the convention walks past rather than a policy.
gateBehaviour: The gate asserts the CURRENT dangling set is a subset of this baseline. A new dangling citation fails and is named. Landing a missing file shrinks the live set and still passes; remove it from this list in the same commit.
notTested: Whether a path that DOES resolve still holds the measurement the citing text claims. A resolving path can carry a stale number; that is a different instrument.
